# Core paths

- **Hannah Arendt:** The Origins of Totalitarianism → The Human Condition → Between Past and Future: Eight Exercises in Political Thought → Eichmann in Jerusalem: A Report on the Banality of Evil
- **Aristotle:** Categories → Physics → Metaphysics → Nicomachean Ethics → De Anima (On the Soul)
- **Henri Bergson:** "Introduction to Metaphysics" → Time and Free Will: An Essay on the Immediate Data of Consciousness → Matter and Memory → Creative Evolution
- **Isaiah Berlin:** "Two Concepts of Liberty" → "Historical Inevitability" → "The Pursuit of the Ideal"
- **Gilles Deleuze:** Nietzsche and Philosophy → Bergsonism → Difference and Repetition → Anti-Oedipus (Capitalism and Schizophrenia, vol. 1) → A Thousand Plateaus (Capitalism and Schizophrenia, vol. 2)
- **Jacques Derrida:** Positions → Voice and Phenomenon (also translated as Speech and Phenomena) → Writing and Difference → Of Grammatology
- **René Descartes:** Discourse on the Method → Meditations on First Philosophy
- **J. G. Fichte:** Concerning the Concept of the Wissenschaftslehre → The Vocation of Man → Foundation of the Entire Wissenschaftslehre (Science of Knowledge)
- **Michel Foucault:** "Nietzsche, Genealogy, History" → Discipline and Punish: The Birth of the Prison → The History of Sexuality, Vol. 1: The Will to Knowledge
- **Sigmund Freud:** Introductory Lectures on Psycho-Analysis → The Interpretation of Dreams → Three Essays on the Theory of Sexuality → Beyond the Pleasure Principle → Civilization and Its Discontents
- **G. W. F. Hegel:** Phenomenology of Spirit
- **Martin Heidegger:** Being and Time → "What Is Metaphysics?" → "The Origin of the Work of Art" → "The Question Concerning Technology" → "Letter on Humanism"
- **Thomas Hobbes:** Leviathan → De Cive (On the Citizen)
- **David Hume:** An Enquiry concerning Human Understanding → A Treatise of Human Nature → An Enquiry concerning the Principles of Morals
- **Edmund Husserl:** Cartesian Meditations: An Introduction to Phenomenology → Logical Investigations → Ideas I (Ideas Pertaining to a Pure Phenomenology: General Introduction to Pure Phenomenology) → The Crisis of European Sciences and Transcendental Phenomenology: An Introduction to Phenomenological Philosophy
- **C. G. Jung:** Memories, Dreams, Reflections → Psychological Types → Two Essays on Analytical Psychology → The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious
- **Immanuel Kant:** Prolegomena to Any Future Metaphysics → Critique of Pure Reason → Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals
- **Jean-François Lyotard:** The Postmodern Condition: A Report on Knowledge → The Differend: Phrases in Dispute → The Inhuman: Reflections on Time
- **Niccolò Machiavelli:** The Prince → Discourses on Livy
- **Karl Marx:** Manifesto of the Communist Party → "Theses on Feuerbach" → Contribution to the Critique of Hegel's Philosophy of Right: Introduction → Preface to A Contribution to the Critique of Political Economy → The German Ideology (Part I, "Feuerbach") → Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844 → Capital, Volume 1
- **Maurice Merleau-Ponty:** Phenomenology of Perception → "Eye and Mind" → The Visible and the Invisible
- **Friedrich Nietzsche:** Twilight of the Idols → The Birth of Tragedy → The Gay Science → Thus Spoke Zarathustra → Beyond Good and Evil → On the Genealogy of Morality
- **Plato:** Apology → Euthyphro → Meno → Crito → Phaedo → Republic
- **Jean-Jacques Rousseau:** Discourse on the Origin of Inequality (Second Discourse) → The Social Contract → Emile, or On Education
- **Jean-Paul Sartre:** Existentialism Is a Humanism → The Transcendence of the Ego → Being and Nothingness: An Essay on Phenomenological Ontology
- **F. W. J. Schelling:** System of Transcendental Idealism → Philosophical Investigations into the Essence of Human Freedom
- **Arthur Schopenhauer:** On the Fourfold Root of the Principle of Sufficient Reason → The World as Will and Representation, vol. 1
- **Baruch Spinoza:** Treatise on the Emendation of the Intellect → Ethics
- **Leo Strauss:** Spinoza's Critique of Religion (read the 1965 preface) → Persecution and the Art of Writing → What Is Political Philosophy? and Other Studies → Natural Right and History
